Where to Deploy an AI Agent: A Decision Guide

Quick thread 🧵
Where you deploy an AI agent depends on how it runs, not on a default.
A simple stateless agent that takes one request and returns one answer can sit happily on a serverless function.
But most useful agents loop through multi-step tool calls, do background or scheduled work, hold API keys, and keep memory.
Those traits fit a persistent, always-on server better than scale-to-zero serverless.
